SMTO-TSK-0032 — Workflows are turned off in this SMTO

GUID: d83ee255-a8c6-4f6a-aded-46f3d35a27ee
Slug: recipe-disabled
Domain: TSK · Subsystem: tsk

What happened

  • Workflows, which are saved prompts you can run again later, are switched off for this installation, so SMTO couldn't save, preview, run or schedule one. Workflows you already saved are kept.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask the person who manages SMTO to turn workflows on, if your organization allows them. This switch is set for the whole installation, not in your own Settings.
  2. Until then, send the prompt yourself as a normal message in a conversation. Ordinary messages still work while workflows are off.
  3. After workflows are turned on, reload the page and open Workflows again. The page needs to reload to pick up the change.

What success looks like

  • Workflows opens and you can select Run now or Save workflow without seeing this message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete your saved workflows; they are kept and will work again once workflows are turned on.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The effective agent_recipes_enabled setting is false, so a workflow (recipe) create, run, preview or schedule request was refused.

What this means

  • The effective recipe feature flag is disabled at create, execute, preview or scheduling admission. Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.

Why this can happen

  • The effective recipe feature flag is disabled at create, execute, preview or scheduling admission.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the owning accepted agent_recipes_enabled configuration and feature route.

How to fix it

  • If workflows are intended, set AOR_AGENT_RECIPES_ENABLED=true (installation setting agent_recipes_enabled; the runtime control of the same name overrides it) and restart the Server. Existing workflows are untouched and still pass normal validation and permission checks when run.
  • Enable recipes through the owning configuration only if intended. Existing saved work remains subject to current authority and evidence checks.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Intended configuration enables the feature and ordinary recipe validation still passes.

What not to do

  • Do not remove retained state or weaken trust checks to make an unavailable dependency appear healthy.

Technical notes

  • Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
